messages.content: How do I reset my password?
Open Settings, then Security, and select Reset Password.
What is the refund window?
Refunds are available within 14 days of purchase.
How can I contact support?
Use the support chat inside the application.
Where can I download an invoice?
Open Billing and select the invoice download button.
Can I change the interface language?
Choose your preferred language in Settings under Language.
How do I sign out?
Open the profile menu and select Sign out.
Where do I update my display name?
Edit the display name in your profile settings.
Can I disable notifications?
Turn off notifications in Settings under Notifications.
How do I view the app version?
Open Help and choose About to see the version number.
Where is the user guide?
Select Documentation from the Help menu.
